lesson.menu_desc: Descrever passo a passo como um aroma sai da matéria-prima e chega ao cliente, com it is made / it is tested / it is shipped -- 27 slides
lesson.subtitle: Lesson 27 -- How It Is Made
lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Rodrigo Luiz | Lesson 27 -- How It Is Made
lesson.grammar_point: present simple passive as a process chunk (it is made / it is tested / it is shipped)

listenings.text: Hi Rodrigo, it's Claire. Quick news from France. Our new vanilla flavor is ready. The formula is created in Grasse, and the flavor is made in three plants: in France for Europe, in China for Asia, and in Brazil for South America. The samples are ready, and they are sent to you today. Please test them and tell me what you think.

Welcome to the New York subway. More than three million people use it every day. The trains are cleaned every night, and the stations are checked every morning. Tickets are not sold on the train: you pay at the gate, with your card or your phone. Enjoy your trip!

extra_audio.text: First, the formula is created in the lab. Then the ingredients are weighed. They are mixed in big tanks. Every batch is tested in the quality lab. Finally, the flavor is packed and shipped to the customer.
